item.title: Stray Kids announce dominATE World Tour U.S. dates
item.description: Stray Kids will play Los Angeles (Crypto.com Arena, Dec 5) and Newark (Prudential Center, Dec 9), plus Toronto. Tickets on sale Oct 25.
